name: What should I prepare before requesting a quote for a detached in-law suite?
description: Gather your property survey, check HOA rules, and outline essential living needs such as accessibility features, bathroom layouts, and kitchen size.

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before requesting a quote for a detached in-law suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before reaching out to a contractor, verify your property boundaries, locate any underground utility easements, and check your HOA covenants if you live in a deed-restricted community like Bloomingdale or Providence Lakes. It is also helpful to determine your priority features: decide whether you need full accessibility accommodations like zero-threshold roll-in showers, determine if a full kitchen or small kitchenette suits the occupant, and establish your target budget. Having these details ready speeds up the initial project evaluation and drafting phase.
